description: This file defines the CommitMessageGenerator class responsible for generating commit messages using AI, with methods for building prompts, calling AI services, and extracting messages from responses.

classes.name: CommitMessageGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating commit messages via AI, managing prompt creation, API calls, and response parsing.

methods.name: generateMessage
methods.description: Generates a commit message based on provided git context and progress callback.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Constructs the prompt for AI based on git context and previous messages, including instructions for generating different messages.

methods.name: callAIForCommitMessage
methods.description: Handles the process of selecting API configuration, calling the AI service, and returning the generated commit message.

methods.name: extractCommitMessage
methods.description: Cleans and extracts the commit message from the AI response string.
